powerBanks.name: Bank B1
powerBanks.source: printed on unit front panel (user photo): "MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET 10 AMPS, MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET BANK (B1 OR B2) 16 AMPS" and "OUTPUT: 220-240 VAC 50/60HZ, 32A". 230 V is the nominal value within the printed 220–240 V range. Each bank has its own breaker (B1 top row outlets 1–8, B2 bottom row outlets 9–16).

source: Outlets-front orientation: the mounting brackets sit forward of the body so plugged IEC plugs stay behind the rack front. User measured ear plane to rear of body as about 195 mm (approximate; an earlier estimate was 190–195 mm). With the 114 mm body this places the outlet face 81 mm behind the ear plane (derived, approximate). Parts-only geometry: one body solid from z = 81 to 195 mm and two bracket side plates spanning the ear plane to the body front, just outside the body (|x| 222.5–224.5 mm, 449 mm overall). The plates' 2 mm thickness (from the approximate 449 mm overall width) and full-height rectangular profile are APPROXIMATE envelopes (the photographed brackets are angled plates); the recess in front of every outlet, the management ports and the input cord exit stays open. Body 445 mm wide × 114 mm deep × 2U tall without the ears: user-entered measurement, consistent with the Schneider Electric product page https://shop.se.com/pro/ca/en/product/rack-pdu-switched-2u-32a-230v-16-c13/ (2U, W445 × D114 × H89 mm rounded, 4.5 kg, 16 × IEC C13, IEC 60309 32 A input; retailer listings give 444.5 × 114.3 × 88.9 mm and 4.5 kg). heightMm is 88.9 mm, the 2U nominal: the user gave the height as 2U and the catalogue 89 mm is rounded, so no more precise height is claimed. Width across the bracket side plates: the user reported "something like 449 mm wide" with the ears/brackets; this is INTERPRETED (pending user confirmation) as the overall width across the bracket side plates that run alongside the body, about 2 mm per side outside the 445 mm body, not the ear-flange width. The ears still screw to the rack rails at 465.1 mm centres, so faceWidthMm stays at the 482.6 mm 19-inch nominal (PROVISIONAL, not measured). Per-outlet and per-bank current limits and the 220–240 V, 32 A output rating are printed on the unit front panel (user photo); see powerBanks. Input: a captive, hardwired IEC 60309 32 A cord that leaves the outlet face at its left end as seen facing the outlets (user description); the `input` endpoint is the cord exit on the body, and the cord length to the plug is unknown (3.05–3.66 m depending on source). PROVISIONAL: ear thickness unknown (2 mm illustrative preview), ear screw holes at 22.225/66.675 mm (middle hole of each U) are a placeholder pending confirmation, faceWidthMm 482.6 is the nominal 19-inch width, and every port centre is a placeholder (see each port). PDU power draw is not published here and is not set. No rail kit or other manufacturer compatibility is inferred.

ports.name: Input cord · IEC 60309 32 A
ports.source: PROVISIONAL centre: captive, hardwired IEC 60309 32 A input cord (connector type from the catalogue). The user states the cord enters on the outlet face at the left end as seen facing the IEC outlets, so it sits on the same face as the outlets, left of outlet 1 and outlet 9. This endpoint is the cord exit on the PDU body, 2 mm proud of the outlet face and pointing out of it; it is not a socket, and the plug end lies a further 3.05–3.66 m away depending on source, so cord length is unknown. The exact horizontal and vertical offsets were not measured: x = 205 mm (centre 17.5 mm in from the body's left end, clear of outlet 1/9's apertures) at mid-height is a placeholder, and the 20 × 20 mm aperture is an illustrative cord-exit size.
